TUTORIAL
How to create a personalized joke:
Go to the Template Section and choose the joke template. You may listen to it by clicking on the icon with the character;
Tap on the text and enter the first, middle (optional), and last name;
Wait for the entered data to be approved;
Listen to the approved joke. If necessary, change the entered name's spelling using the rules from the hint provided;
Share the personalized joke link with friends, relatives, colleagues, or others on social media.

Only existing first, middle or last names can be approved and voiced. Other words or phrases won't be voiced.


DISCLAIMER
All the voices in this app are parodied by Artificial Intelligence (AI).
This app is only for humoristic and entertainment purposes and does not aim to insult or anyone.

Only existing first, middle, and last names may be voiced. If the data entered by the user consists of the real name and other irrelevant words, they will be declined and will not be voiced.

Moderation rules:
Data entered by users is subject to obligatory moderation before voicing.
The following content won't be voiced:
* containing information and/or images discrediting honor, dignity, and business reputation of third parties, and information promulgating violence, pornography, drugs, racial hatred, other illegal actions, or other prohibited information;
* violating the norms of the applicable law and general standards of morality and decency;
* suggested for the purposes contrary to the norms of the applicable law and general standards of morality and decency;
* suggested for advertising of any goods, brands, services.
